assertions.description: WebTransportDatagramsWritable exists and extends WritableStream directly.
WebTransportDatagramsWritable.prototype exposes the mutable sendGroup and sendOrder attributes.
assertions.test: typeof WebTransportDatagramsWritable === 'function' && 'sendGroup' in WebTransportDatagramsWritable.prototype && 'sendOrder' in WebTransportDatagramsWritable.prototype

assertions.description: createWritable() on a connecting transport returns a WritableStream with the WebTransportSendOptions defaults: sendGroup null, sendOrder 0.
assertions.test: (() => { if (typeof WebTransport !== 'function') return false; try { const t = new WebTransport('https://127.0.0.1:44443/never'); t.ready.catch(() => {}); t.closed.catch(() => {}); if (!('createWritable' in Object.getPrototypeOf(t.datagrams))) { try { t.close(); } catch {} return false; } const w = t.datagrams.createWritable(); const ok = w instanceof WritableStream && w.sendGroup === null && w.sendOrder === 0; try { t.close(); } catch {} return ok; } catch { return false; } })()

assertions.description: A sendOrder passed to createWritable is stored (7 in, 7 out) and the attribute is mutable on the live object (assigning 42 reads back 42).
assertions.test: (() => { if (typeof WebTransport !== 'function') return false; try { const t = new WebTransport('https://127.0.0.1:44443/never'); t.ready.catch(() => {}); t.closed.catch(() => {}); if (!('createWritable' in Object.getPrototypeOf(t.datagrams))) { try { t.close(); } catch {} return false; } const w = t.datagrams.createWritable({ sendOrder: 7 }); const first = w.sendOrder === 7; w.sendOrder = 42; const second = w.sendOrder === 42; try { t.close(); } catch {} return first && second; } catch { return false; } })()

assertions.description: Two createWritable() calls return distinct stream objects — independent queues, the core of the feature.
assertions.test: (() => { if (typeof WebTransport !== 'function') return false; try { const t = new WebTransport('https://127.0.0.1:44443/never'); t.ready.catch(() => {}); t.closed.catch(() => {}); if (!('createWritable' in Object.getPrototypeOf(t.datagrams))) { try { t.close(); } catch {} return false; } const a = t.datagrams.createWritable(); const b = t.datagrams.createWritable(); const ok = a !== b; try { t.close(); } catch {} return ok; } catch { return false; } })()

assertions.description: Writing a non-BufferSource into a datagram writable rejects with TypeError (writeDatagrams step 2).
assertions.test: (async () => { if (typeof WebTransport !== 'function') return false; try { const t = new WebTransport('https://127.0.0.1:44443/never'); t.ready.catch(() => {}); t.closed.catch(() => {}); const dg = t.datagrams; const writer = ('createWritable' in Object.getPrototypeOf(dg)) ? dg.createWritable().getWriter() : ('writable' in dg ? dg.writable.getWriter() : null); if (!writer) { try { t.close(); } catch {} return false; } const r = await Promise.race([writer.write('not bytes').then(() => 'resolved', (e) => (e instanceof TypeError ? 'typeerror' : 'other')), new Promise((res) => setTimeout(() => res('timeout'), 3000))]); try { t.close(); } catch {} return r === 'typeerror'; } catch { return false; } })()

assertions.description: Writing a datagram larger than maxDatagramSize resolves with undefined (silent discard), rather than rejecting (writeDatagrams step 4).
assertions.test: (async () => { if (typeof WebTransport !== 'function') return false; try { const t = new WebTransport('https://127.0.0.1:44443/never'); t.ready.catch(() => {}); t.closed.catch(() => {}); const dg = t.datagrams; const writer = ('createWritable' in Object.getPrototypeOf(dg)) ? dg.createWritable().getWriter() : ('writable' in dg ? dg.writable.getWriter() : null); if (!writer) { try { t.close(); } catch {} return false; } const r = await Promise.race([writer.write(new Uint8Array(dg.maxDatagramSize * 2)).then((v) => (v === undefined ? 'resolved-undefined' : 'resolved-other'), () => 'rejected'), new Promise((res) => setTimeout(() => res('timeout'), 3000))]); try { t.close(); } catch {} return r === 'resolved-undefined'; } catch { return false; } })()

assertions.description: On an established session, queued bytes on a higher-sendOrder datagram writable drain ahead of a lower one's queue. Observing wire order needs a live HTTP/3 endpoint, which this showcase cannot reach.
assertions.test: Requires a live HTTP/3 WebTransport server echoing datagram arrival order.
